entries.en: The printer can use recycled paper as well as paper made from virgin fibre.
entries.zh: 这台打印机既能使用再生纸，也能使用原生纤维制成的纸。

entries.en: A red dot on the map marks the campsite.
entries.zh: 地图上的一个红点标出了营地的位置。

entries.en: Our visit happened to coincide with the village music festival.
entries.zh: 我们到访时，恰好赶上了村里的音乐节。

entries.en: He carried a ladder into the orchard to pick the highest apples.
entries.zh: 他把梯子搬进果园，去摘最高处的苹果。

entries.en: One of my ancestors built boats in this harbour.
entries.zh: 我的一位祖先曾在这个港口造船。

entries.en: The empty bird cage hung beside an open window.
entries.zh: 空鸟笼挂在一扇敞开的窗户旁。

entries.en: Use a ruler to measure the width of each photograph.
entries.zh: 用直尺测量每张照片的宽度。

entries.en: The zoo keeper scattered food among the rocks for the penguins.
entries.zh: 动物园饲养员把食物撒在岩石间，供企鹅取食。

entries.en: His hostile tone made a simple discussion unnecessarily tense.
entries.zh: 他充满敌意的语气让一次简单的讨论变得紧张起来。

entries.en: The committee met to formulate a plan for the unused courtyard.
entries.zh: 委员会开会，为闲置庭院制订利用方案。

entries.en: The songs reminded her of the homeland she had left as a child.
entries.zh: 这些歌使她想起童年时离开的祖国。

entries.en: Leave the wet umbrellas on the rack by the door.
entries.zh: 把湿雨伞放在门边的架子上。

entries.en: The art students tried to reproduce the colours of the sunset in paint.
entries.zh: 美术学生试着用颜料再现日落的色彩。

entries.en: Their correspondence fills three boxes in the university archive.
entries.zh: 他们的往来信件在大学档案馆里装了三箱。

entries.meaningZh: 表演或特定场合穿的服装
entries.en: Her costume for the school play included a silver cape.
entries.zh: 她在学校戏剧中的服装包括一件银色斗篷。

entries.en: We had soup and fresh bread for supper after the long walk.
entries.zh: 长途步行后，我们晚餐吃了汤和新鲜面包。

entries.en: The newspaper printed a cartoon about the town's endless roadworks.
entries.zh: 报纸刊登了一幅讽刺镇上道路施工没完没了的漫画。

entries.en: We crept past the bedroom so we would not wake the baby.
entries.zh: 我们蹑手蹑脚地走过卧室，以免吵醒婴儿。

entries.en: A small bug caused the calendar to display every date twice.
entries.zh: 一个小程序错误导致日历把每个日期都显示了两次。

entries.en: At the ceremony, the priest blessed the fishing boats before they left.
entries.zh: 仪式上，牧师在渔船出航前为它们祈福。

entries.en: The author explains the mathematics in an accessible style.
entries.zh: 作者用易懂的文风解释这些数学内容。

entries.en: The organisers deemed the hall too small for the expected audience.
entries.zh: 组织者认为，这间礼堂容纳不了预计到场的观众。

entries.en: Every inhabitant of the island received an invitation to the celebration.
entries.zh: 岛上的每位居民都收到了庆典邀请。

entries.en: We classified the shells by shape before measuring their size.
entries.zh: 测量大小前，我们先按形状给贝壳分类。

entries.en: A little paint had dried on the sleeve of my shirt.
entries.zh: 我的衬衫袖子上有一点已经干了的颜料。

entries.en: A lamb squeezed through the fence and followed us along the path.
entries.zh: 一只小羊钻过栅栏，沿着小路跟着我们。

entries.meaningZh: 无力偿还债务而破产的状态
entries.en: The novel follows a shopkeeper struggling to avoid bankruptcy.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位店主奋力避免破产的故事。

entries.en: The museum display traces the development of a vaccine through old laboratory notebooks.
entries.zh: 博物馆展览通过旧实验笔记追溯一种疫苗的研制过程。

entries.en: Our final exam includes a short essay and three practical problems.
entries.zh: 我们的期末考试包括一篇短文和三道实际问题。

entries.en: The spare batteries are in the top drawer of the desk.
entries.zh: 备用电池在书桌最上面的抽屉里。

entries.en: The exhibition grew out of a collaboration between a photographer and a poet.
entries.zh: 这个展览源于一位摄影师与一位诗人的合作。

entries.en: Teaching the puppy to wait required more patience than I expected.
entries.zh: 教小狗学会等待需要的耐心比我预想的更多。

entries.meaningZh: 天体或航天器运行的轨道
entries.en: The animation shows the satellite moving in orbit around Earth.
entries.zh: 动画展示了卫星沿轨道绕地球运行的情形。

entries.en: The owl waited silently for its prey to emerge from the grass.
entries.zh: 猫头鹰静静等着猎物从草丛中出现。

entries.en: Park staff patrol the beach each morning before visitors arrive.
entries.zh: 公园工作人员每天早上在游客到来前巡视海滩。

entries.en: The new editor kept the reading group started by her predecessor.
entries.zh: 新编辑保留了前任创办的读书小组。

entries.meaningZh: 出人意料的发现或披露
entries.en: The revelation that the quiet gardener was a famous pianist surprised us all.
entries.zh: 得知那位安静的园丁竟是著名钢琴家，我们都很惊讶。

entries.en: The provincial museum lent several paintings to the local gallery.
entries.zh: 省博物馆借出了几幅画，供当地画廊展览。

entries.en: It took four people to haul the waterlogged boat onto the beach.
entries.zh: 四个人才把那艘进了水的船拖上海滩。

entries.en: In the film, the carpenter makes a plain wooden coffin for his friend.
entries.zh: 电影中，木匠为朋友做了一口朴素的木棺材。

entries.en: The children pulled a small wagon full of pumpkins to the stall.
entries.zh: 孩子们拉着一辆装满南瓜的小四轮车来到摊位。

entries.en: The new edition contains a notable improvement in the quality of the maps.
entries.zh: 新版地图的质量有了显著改善。

entries.en: The entrance hall has a floor of pale green marble.
entries.zh: 门厅铺着淡绿色的大理石地板。

entries.en: The farmer's patient ass carried baskets along the narrow mountain trail.
entries.zh: 农夫那头温顺的驴驮着篮子，沿狭窄的山路前行。

entries.en: She placed a biscuit beside each cup of tea.
entries.zh: 她在每杯茶旁边放了一块饼干。

entries.en: He turned up his collar against the cold wind.
entries.zh: 他竖起衣领抵挡寒风。

entries.en: The greenhouse was filled with exotic flowers from distant islands.
entries.zh: 温室里满是来自遥远岛屿的异国花卉。

entries.en: A large brown bull stood alone in the field beyond the barn.
entries.zh: 一头棕色大公牛独自站在谷仓那边的田里。

entries.en: A metal clip held the pages together in the wind.
entries.zh: 一个金属夹子把纸页夹住，防止被风吹散。

entries.en: We sheltered from the rain in an abandoned fishing hut.
entries.zh: 我们在一间废弃的渔棚里避雨。

entries.en: The pocket on the side of his trousers reached halfway down his thigh.
entries.zh: 他裤子侧面的口袋一直延伸到大腿中部。

entries.en: The first failed attempt did not discourage her from trying again.
entries.zh: 第一次尝试失败并没有使她失去再次尝试的信心。

entries.en: Our debate team displayed its trophy in the school library.
entries.zh: 我们辩论队把奖杯陈列在学校图书馆里。

entries.en: They remained intimate friends despite living on different continents.
entries.zh: 尽管住在不同的大洲，他们仍是亲密的朋友。

entries.en: The factory trained its entire workforce to use the new equipment.
entries.zh: 工厂培训了全体员工使用新设备。

entries.en: We watched a documentary about the restoration of an old sailing ship.
entries.zh: 我们看了一部关于修复一艘古老帆船的纪录片。

entries.en: The carrots were tender enough to cut with a fork.
entries.zh: 胡萝卜已经软到用叉子就能切开。

entries.en: For biology homework, we drew the parts of a flower.
entries.zh: 生物作业要求我们画出花的各个部分。

entries.en: The detective in the story discovers a conspiracy to steal the museum's maps.
entries.zh: 故事中的侦探发现了一个盗取博物馆地图的阴谋。

entries.en: A dolphin surfaced beside the boat and disappeared beneath the waves.
entries.zh: 一只海豚在船边浮出水面，又消失在波浪下。

entries.en: We saw the dark tail of a whale rising beyond the harbour wall.
entries.zh: 我们看见一条鲸的深色尾巴在港口防波堤外翘起。

entries.en: The report compares the geographical features of three river valleys.
entries.zh: 报告比较了三个河谷的地理特征。

entries.en: We took an indirect route home to avoid the crowded market.
entries.zh: 我们绕路回家，避开拥挤的市场。

entries.en: You did a terrific job of explaining the rules to the younger children.
entries.zh: 你把规则给小孩子们解释得特别好。

entries.en: Whoever finishes first can choose the next board game.
entries.zh: 谁先完成，谁就可以选择下一个桌游。

entries.en: The diagram represents each atom as a coloured circle.
entries.zh: 这张图用一个彩色圆圈表示一个原子。

entries.en: The museum displayed a model of a dinosaur skull beside the fossil.
entries.zh: 博物馆在化石旁展示了一个恐龙头骨模型。

entries.en: She stitched a small pocket inside the cloth bag.
entries.zh: 她在布包里面缝了一个小口袋。

entries.en: An owl watched us from a branch above the path.
entries.zh: 一只猫头鹰在小路上方的树枝上看着我们。

entries.en: A bee landed on the lavender beside the kitchen window.
entries.zh: 一只蜜蜂落在厨房窗边的薰衣草上。

entries.en: The puppeteer manipulated the tiny wooden hands with almost invisible strings.
entries.zh: 木偶师用几乎看不见的细线操纵着小木手。

entries.en: The research poster included a labelled image of a tumour sample.
entries.zh: 研究海报上有一张带标注的肿瘤样本图像。

entries.en: Make a loose loop in the rope before tying the next knot.
entries.zh: 打下一个结前，先在绳子上留一个松圈。

entries.en: In the classroom model, a small blue bead represents an electron.
entries.zh: 在课堂模型中，一颗蓝色小珠子代表一个电子。

entries.en: The extra piece puzzled us because the model already looked complete.
entries.zh: 这个多出来的零件让我们很困惑，因为模型看上去已经完整了。

entries.en: The illustrator painted a red mushroom beside the tree stump.
entries.zh: 插画师在树桩旁画了一朵红蘑菇。

entries.en: The student used coloured blocks to model an antibody for her science project.
entries.zh: 这名学生用彩色积木制作抗体模型，完成她的科学项目。

entries.en: The play tells the tragic story of two friends separated by war.
entries.zh: 这出戏讲述了两个朋友因战争而分离的悲惨故事。

entries.en: The mechanic found a loose belt under the car's bonnet.
entries.zh: 修理工在汽车引擎盖下发现了一条松动的皮带。

entries.en: The exhibition uses photographs to document the town before and after the earthquake.
entries.zh: 展览用照片记录了这座城镇在地震前后的面貌。

entries.en: I keep buttons of different sizes in an old jam jar.
entries.zh: 我把大小不一的纽扣装在一个旧果酱瓶里。

entries.en: The workshop will utilize spare timber from the theatre renovation.
entries.zh: 工作坊将利用剧院翻修剩下的木料。

entries.meaningZh: 值得投入时间或精力的
entries.en: The climb was worthwhile for the view of the valley alone.
entries.zh: 仅凭山谷的景色，这次攀登就很值得。

entries.en: His vague directions left us unsure which bridge to cross.
entries.zh: 他指路说得含糊，让我们不确定该过哪座桥。

entries.en: A few words of encouragement helped the nervous speaker begin.
entries.zh: 几句鼓励的话帮助紧张的演讲者开了口。

entries.en: The menu lists a pork dish served with apples and potatoes.
entries.zh: 菜单上列有一道配苹果和土豆的猪肉菜。

entries.en: He felt depressed after another week of unsuccessful job applications.
entries.zh: 又一个星期求职无果后，他感到情绪低落。

entries.en: For dessert, we shared a warm pear tart.
entries.zh: 餐后甜点，我们分吃了一份温热的梨挞。

entries.en: The fisherman repaired his net on the harbour steps.
entries.zh: 渔民在港口的台阶上修补渔网。

entries.en: Her conscience would not let her keep the extra change.
entries.zh: 她的良心让她无法留下多找的零钱。

entries.en: One striped sock was hiding inside the duvet cover.
entries.zh: 一只条纹袜藏在被套里面。

entries.en: The young entrepreneur started a business repairing second-hand bicycles.
entries.zh: 这位年轻创业者创办了一家修理二手自行车的企业。

entries.meaningZh: 有同情心并表示理解的
entries.en: My supervisor was sympathetic when I explained why I needed more time.
entries.zh: 我解释为什么需要更多时间后，主管表示了理解。

entries.en: A specialist explained the syndrome to the family.
entries.zh: 一位专科医生向家属解释了这种综合征。

entries.meaningZh: 破坏某事的乐趣或效果
entries.en: Please do not spoil the ending for anyone who has not read the book.
entries.zh: 请不要向还没读过这本书的人透露结局，破坏他们的阅读乐趣。

entries.en: The survey asks employees what they value most about their workplace.
entries.zh: 问卷询问员工最看重工作场所的哪些方面。

entries.en: A light breeze carried the scent of roses through the open door.
entries.zh: 一阵微风把玫瑰香气从敞开的门吹了进来。

entries.en: We cannot say with certainty which route will be quicker.
entries.zh: 我们无法确定哪条路线会更快。

entries.en: Replacing all the windows would be costly, so we repaired the frames first.
entries.zh: 更换所有窗户费用很高，所以我们先修了窗框。

entries.en: Their ambitious plan would turn the abandoned railway into a walking trail.
entries.zh: 他们雄心勃勃的计划是把废弃铁路改成步行道。

entries.en: The lost child's distress eased when she saw her father approaching.
entries.zh: 走失的孩子看到父亲走来，焦急的情绪缓和了。

entries.en: The little shop sells soap wrapped in plain brown paper.
entries.zh: 这家小店卖用普通牛皮纸包着的肥皂。

entries.en: The borrowed telescope is ours to use for a fortnight.
entries.zh: 借来的望远镜可以供我们使用两星期。

entries.en: The magazine's circulation grew after it introduced a gardening section.
entries.zh: 杂志增设园艺栏目后，发行量增加了。

entries.en: The family booked a suite with a separate room for the children.
entries.zh: 这家人订了一套给孩子们配有独立房间的套房。

entries.en: The late delivery caused a brief disturbance during the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 迟来的送货在排练时引起了一阵短暂的骚动。

entries.en: Tighten the screw until the shelf no longer wobbles.
entries.zh: 拧紧螺丝，直到架子不再晃动。

entries.en: The curved handle serves an aesthetic purpose as well as a practical one.
entries.zh: 弯曲的把手既有实用作用，也有美观作用。

entries.en: The scale should read zero before you place the bowl on it.
entries.zh: 把碗放上去之前，秤的读数应该是零。

entries.en: The biology diagram shows where the gut lies inside the animal.
entries.zh: 这张生物示意图标出了肠道在动物体内的位置。

entries.en: The child stirred her juice with a paper straw.
entries.zh: 孩子用纸吸管搅动自己的果汁。

entries.en: A lump of wet clay sat in the middle of the wheel.
entries.zh: 一团湿黏土放在陶轮中央。

entries.en: The volunteers erected a small stage at one end of the square.
entries.zh: 志愿者们在广场一端搭起了一个小舞台。

entries.en: Her bicycle helmet hung from the handlebar by its strap.
entries.zh: 她的自行车头盔用带子挂在车把上。

entries.en: She tied the apron around her waist before starting to cook.
entries.zh: 开始做饭前，她把围裙系在腰间。

entries.en: The baker crushed the nuts with a rolling pin.
entries.zh: 面包师用擀面杖压碎了坚果。

entries.en: Please enclose a photograph of the damaged item with your letter.
entries.zh: 请在信中附上一张损坏物品的照片。

entries.en: The cabin has only minimal furniture, but it feels welcoming.
entries.zh: 小屋里的家具很少，却让人感到亲切。

entries.en: A red cord kept the rolled maps from opening.
entries.zh: 一根红细绳把卷好的地图绑住，防止它们散开。

entries.en: The pipe discharges rainwater into a tank beside the shed.
entries.zh: 这根管子把雨水排入棚屋旁的水箱。

entries.en: The novel explores how cocaine trafficking changed a small port city.
entries.zh: 小说探讨了可卡因走私如何改变一个小港口城市。

entries.en: The mirror created the illusion of a second doorway.
entries.zh: 镜子造成了还有另一扇门的错觉。

entries.en: An anonymous note thanked the neighbours for watering the plants.
entries.zh: 一张匿名便条感谢邻居们帮忙给植物浇水。

entries.en: She can tolerate a little noise, but the constant drilling is distracting.
entries.zh: 她能容忍一点噪声，但不停的钻孔声让人分心。

entries.en: The loose cable across the doorway was a tripping hazard.
entries.zh: 门口横着的松散电缆有绊倒人的危险。

entries.en: The elephant lifted a fallen branch with its trunk.
entries.zh: 大象用鼻子举起一根掉落的树枝。

entries.en: We scrambled over the rocks to reach the little cove.
entries.zh: 我们手脚并用地爬过岩石，到达了那个小海湾。

entries.en: The village shop seldom closes before sunset in summer.
entries.zh: 夏天，村里的商店很少在日落前关门。

entries.en: A short discussion will precede the afternoon workshop.
entries.zh: 下午的工作坊之前会有一场简短讨论。

entries.en: A steady pulse from the drums held the dancers together.
entries.zh: 鼓声稳定的节拍让舞者们保持一致。

entries.meaningZh: 使事物持续发展的势头
entries.en: The fundraising campaign gained momentum after the first concert.
entries.zh: 第一场音乐会之后，筹款活动的势头增强了。

entries.meaningZh: 与预期相反的讽刺意味
entries.en: The irony was that our guide got lost before any of the visitors did.
entries.zh: 讽刺的是，游客们还没迷路，导游却先迷路了。

entries.en: Pour the remaining liquid into a measuring jug.
entries.zh: 把剩下的液体倒进量杯。

entries.en: A wooden spoon rested across the top of the saucepan.
entries.zh: 一把木勺横放在炖锅上。

entries.en: The exhibition lets visitors interact with a model of the city's transport network.
entries.zh: 展览让参观者与城市交通网络模型进行互动。

entries.en: In the midst of packing, I found the camera I had lost last year.
entries.zh: 收拾行李的过程中，我找到了去年丢失的相机。

entries.en: He showed remarkable restraint when the conversation became heated.
entries.zh: 谈话变得激烈时，他表现出极大的克制。

entries.en: Much of the cafe's charm comes from its mismatched furniture.
entries.zh: 这家咖啡馆的魅力很大程度上来自风格各异的家具。

entries.en: The shorter version omits the long description of the journey.
entries.zh: 较短的版本省去了对旅程的长篇描述。

entries.en: There is a contradiction between the map and the directions on the website.
entries.zh: 地图与网站上的路线说明之间存在矛盾。

entries.en: Heavy snow led to the suspension of the mountain bus service.
entries.zh: 大雪导致山区公交服务暂停。

entries.en: A thin white vein runs through the dark marble.
entries.zh: 一道细白纹贯穿深色大理石。

entries.en: Residents signed a petition asking for a pedestrian crossing near the school.
entries.zh: 居民们签署联名请求书，要求在学校附近设置人行横道。

entries.en: She filled a basin with water to rinse the paintbrushes.
entries.zh: 她在盆里装满水，用来冲洗画笔。

entries.en: My purse was still in the coat I wore yesterday.
entries.zh: 我的钱包还在昨天穿的外套里。

entries.en: The shared garden helped foster friendships between neighbours.
entries.zh: 共用花园帮助邻居之间建立了友谊。

entries.en: The expedition collected rock samples from the island's northern cliffs.
entries.zh: 探险队从岛屿北部的悬崖采集了岩石样本。

entries.en: The class watched a recorded debate from the national legislature.
entries.zh: 全班观看了一段国家立法机关辩论的录像。

entries.en: Her plea for volunteers brought twenty neighbours to the garden on Sunday.
entries.zh: 她恳求大家来当志愿者，周日便有二十位邻居来到花园帮忙。

entries.en: The display traces coffee from a farm crop to a global commodity.
entries.zh: 展览追溯了咖啡从农作物成为全球商品的过程。

entries.meaningZh: 专门培训的学校或学院
entries.en: He teaches drawing at an art academy near the river.
entries.zh: 他在河边一所艺术学院教绘画。

entries.en: I left my bicycle in the station's covered parking area.
entries.zh: 我把自行车停在车站有顶棚的停车区。

entries.en: Her quiet acts of goodness mattered more than any public praise.
entries.zh: 她默默做出的善举比任何公开赞扬都更有分量。

entries.en: He refused to cheat at cards even when nobody was watching.
entries.zh: 即使没有人看着，他也不愿在打牌时作弊。

entries.en: The teacher supplemented the textbook with photographs from her own travels.
entries.zh: 老师用自己旅行时拍的照片补充课本内容。

entries.en: In her diary, she described the week she spent at home with a fever.
entries.zh: 她在日记中描述了因发烧在家度过的那一周。

entries.en: One blue tile was missing from the pattern around the fountain.
entries.zh: 喷泉周围的图案缺了一块蓝色瓷砖。

entries.en: The sign was partially hidden behind a flowering bush.
entries.zh: 标牌被一丛开花的灌木遮住了一部分。

entries.en: The manual includes a diagram showing how to fold the table.
entries.zh: 手册里有一张示意图，说明如何折叠这张桌子。

entries.en: The idea originated in a conversation between two students on a bus.
entries.zh: 这个想法源于两个学生在公交车上的一次谈话。

entries.en: We had to shove the heavy door to get it open.
entries.zh: 我们得用力推，才能把那扇沉重的门打开。

entries.en: They moored the boat beside a wooden landing stage.
entries.zh: 他们把船系泊在木制登船台旁。

entries.en: The twins look alike, but their voices are quite different.
entries.zh: 这对双胞胎长得相像，但声音很不一样。

entries.en: I set a reminder on my phone to return the library books.
entries.zh: 我在手机上设了一个提醒，提醒自己归还图书馆的书。

entries.en: The museum has a room devoted to the history of the local regiment.
entries.zh: 博物馆有一个展室专门介绍当地驻军团的历史。

entries.en: Each grandchild planted a flower beside their grandmother's new bench.
entries.zh: 每个孙辈都在祖母的新长椅旁种了一株花。

entries.en: The original manuscript remains in the custody of the university library.
entries.zh: 原稿仍由大学图书馆保管。

entries.en: The students studied the ecological changes around the restored pond.
entries.zh: 学生们研究了修复后的池塘周围的生态变化。

entries.en: Her interest in electronics began when she built a small radio.
entries.zh: 她制作了一台小收音机后，开始对电子学感兴趣。

entries.en: The footpath follows the shore of the lake behind the dam.
entries.zh: 步道沿着水坝后方湖泊的岸边延伸。

entries.meaningZh: 使人处于不利地位的障碍
entries.en: The lack of a rehearsal room was a serious handicap for the band.
entries.zh: 缺少排练室是乐队面临的一大障碍。

entries.en: They outfitted the van with shelves for their travelling bookshop.
entries.zh: 他们为货车装上书架，把它用作流动书店。

entries.en: The tiny festival attracted an unprecedented number of visitors this year.
entries.zh: 今年这个小型节庆吸引了前所未有的游客人数。

entries.en: A small defect in the hinge prevented the box from closing properly.
entries.zh: 铰链上的一个小缺陷使盒子无法正常合上。

entries.en: The exhibition displays the inventor's original drawings beside a copy of the patent.
entries.zh: 展览在专利文件副本旁展示了发明者的原始图纸。

entries.en: The skeleton model has a flexible spine that bends at several joints.
entries.zh: 这个骨架模型的脊柱可以在几个关节处弯曲。

entries.en: We waited in the hotel lounge while our room was being prepared.
entries.zh: 房间尚在整理时，我们在酒店休息室等候。

entries.en: I sketched the bridge in pencil before adding any colour.
entries.zh: 我先用铅笔画了桥的草图，然后才上色。

entries.meaningZh: 材料表面的质感或纹理
entries.en: The rough texture of the cloth contrasted with the smooth wooden frame.
entries.zh: 布料粗糙的质感与光滑的木框形成了对比。

entries.meaningZh: 表示恼怒的轻度咒骂语
entries.en: Damn, I left the umbrella on the train again!
entries.zh: 该死，我又把伞落在火车上了！

entries.en: The old map shows a railway crossing the frontier near the mountains.
entries.zh: 旧地图显示，一条铁路在群山附近穿过国境。

entries.en: The biology assignment asks us to make a model of a hormone molecule.
entries.zh: 生物作业要求我们制作一个激素分子模型。

entries.en: The magnetic strip holds our shopping list against the fridge door.
entries.zh: 磁条把我们的购物清单固定在冰箱门上。

entries.en: The novel follows a clerk working in a vast and confusing bureaucracy.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一名职员在庞大而复杂的官僚机构中工作的故事。

entries.en: Her ballet class ends with a short dance accompanied by piano music.
entries.zh: 她的芭蕾课以一段钢琴伴奏的短舞结束。

entries.en: The town hopes to develop tourism without losing its quiet character.
entries.zh: 这个小镇希望发展旅游业，同时保留宁静的特色。

entries.en: She keeps a small notebook for sketches of buildings she passes.
entries.zh: 她用一本小笔记本画下沿途经过的建筑。

entries.en: In the tale, a wounded beast finds shelter in the gardener's shed.
entries.zh: 故事中，一头受伤的野兽躲进了园丁的棚屋。

entries.en: The anatomy textbook includes a detailed drawing of the bowel.
entries.zh: 解剖学课本中有一幅详细的肠道图。

entries.en: Her hands trembled as she opened the envelope containing the results.
entries.zh: 她打开装着结果的信封时，双手在颤抖。

entries.en: The renovation uncovered a painted ceiling beneath the plaster.
entries.zh: 翻修时，人们发现灰泥下面藏着彩绘天花板。

entries.en: The composer wrote a short piece for flute and cello.
entries.zh: 作曲家为长笛和大提琴写了一首短曲。

entries.en: Their innovative storage system turns unused stair space into drawers.
entries.zh: 他们创新的储物系统把闲置的楼梯空间变成了抽屉。

entries.en: The tag on the suitcase had faded until the address was unreadable.
entries.zh: 行李箱上的标签已经褪色，地址都看不清了。

entries.en: The heavy rain compelled us to move the performance indoors.
entries.zh: 大雨迫使我们把演出移到了室内。

entries.en: A banner above the door proclaimed the opening of the new bookshop.
entries.zh: 门上方的一条横幅宣布新书店开业。

entries.en: Our Sunday hike ended at a waterfall hidden among the pines.
entries.zh: 我们周日的远足终点是一处藏在松林中的瀑布。

entries.en: The hall will open at six; meantime, we can wait in the cafe.
entries.zh: 大厅六点开放；在这期间，我们可以在咖啡馆等候。

entries.en: The children were enthusiastic about building their own bird feeders.
entries.zh: 孩子们对亲手制作喂鸟器很有热情。

entries.en: The scent of fresh bread drifted from the bakery into the street.
entries.zh: 新鲜面包的香气从面包店飘到了街上。
